overview: This Senate resolution thanks Senator Patty Murray of Washington for her service as President pro tempore of the Senate, the senator who presides when the Vice President is absent, a role she held in the previous Congress. As a token of appreciation, it gives her the honorary title of President Pro Tempore Emerita. The title is ceremonial. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 3, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a courteous recognition of a senator's service in one of the Senate's top posts.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
